{{Top|leg}}
A '''material synthesizer''' was a piece of [[Gree technology]]. It reconfigured the nuclear structure of matter to create items by turning common elements such as [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]], [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], and [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] into rarer and more valuable elements, isotopes, or chemicals.<ref name="The Gree Enclave">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref>
